protocol: Restart Trino and clear runner page cache before each query block. Open a fresh RedisCluster client for one exact direct FT.AGGREGATE COUNT health check before each block and after each query attempt. Execute three attempts per query block without query retries.
scope: QPF measures Redis query worker allocation; it does not enable connector multi-split scanning

healthCoverage.note: Pre-attempt health is covered by the block-level check; each attempt receives a fresh-client post-check.
